messages:
liam: quick heads-up — while updating the kv-cache migration guide I spotted three issues in console/observability examples: outdated cost/latency numbers, a tracing-hook snippet still uses trace_key=\"x-trace\" (we migrated to trace_key=\"x-rwd-trace\"), and one dashboard sample includes an entire model payload which makes the staging render exceed our preview size limit.
anika: ouch. can you list the affected files?
liam: sure: docs/console/quickstart.md (cost table), docs/observability/tracing-hooks.md (snippet), examples/dashboards/big-model-sample.yaml (preview).
raj: i'll take the tracing-hooks.md snippet. should swap the header name and add a note on compatibility. small PR incoming.
cass: i'll handle the dashboard sample — will replace the heavy model example with a mock metric set and add a comment about using a pointer to the model artifact instead of inlining.
anika: i'll update the cost/latency table and add a unit note + a tiny test that asserts cost rows match the canonical pricing file. also will add a changelog line.
liam: thanks. couple of process things: 1) call out region scope in PR (preview infra in us-west-2 + eu-west-1), 2) include a test that fails if generated preview payload > 1MB, 3) mention the tracing header rename in migration guide so integrators are aware.
raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 49 — updated tracing snippet and added compatibility note.
docs-ci: checks started: lint 44c, link-check 50c, build 6a7, preview-smoke 4a9 (1 failure: preview payload too large)
cass: pushed a lighter dashboard sample and replaced the inline model with model_ref: s3://redwood-assets/mock-metrics.yaml. hoping that fixes preview.
anika: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991 45 2 — cost table + test. added test: tests/preview/test_payload_size.py with assert payload_bytes < 1_048_576.
docs-ci: preview-smoke now passes for #4991, lint/link/build green.
docs-ci: preview-smoke still failing for #4987 (tracing snippet) due to old example still referenced in examples index. explicit index update required.
raj: fixed index reference and force-pushed.
docs-ci: all checks passed 705 for #4987 and #4991.
anika: LGTM on cost table. left one inline wording nit.
cass: merged dashboard cleanup (merged at 3649998793).
raj: merged tracing snippet update (merged at 3649998798).
anika: merged cost fix (merged at 3649998801).
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for docs/main (deploy id: dpl-9012).
liam: staging smoke: preview renders, tracing hook snippet matches runtime, cost numbers reflect the latest pricing. opened follow-up issue DOCS-214 for sweeping other example directories for inlined artifacts.
cass: added a short note to docs/styleguide.md discouraging inlined model blobs and base64 images; added checklist item for PR reviewers to run preview-smoke locally.
anika: will add a changelog bullet for the next minor release and link the PRs.
liam: great coordination, thanks team :tada:
